blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur—Months after his untimely demise, outpourings of grief, love, and demands for justice continue to trail the late Agusan del Sur basketball standout Rene “Bobet” Baterbonia, as floral tributes and prayers flooded his gravesite in Talacogon, Agusan del Sur on All Saints’ and All Souls’ Day (Undas). Supporters, friends, and fans from across the country and overseas have been sending elaborate flower standees to his resting place at the Talacogon New Cemetery in Barangay Labnig since October 31.
